_comment: This file lists the kinds of file a Zeebo project can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. A project is one game, and optionally what the game already saved. Zeebx needs nothing else: it stands in for the console's system software.

slots.title: Game
slots.help: The game as it was dumped from a console: a .7z or .zip archive with a 'mif' folder and a 'mod' folder in it, or the game's .mod file. Zeebx's compatibility list (github.com/ZeebxTeam/zeebx-emu, COMPATIBILIDADE.md) says which games work.

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: What the game already saved, as Emulator > Export Save Data... wrote it. It is a .zip of the console's saves folder, and it is put back before the game starts.
